title: Refunds, Budgets, and Analysis

baseline.workingCopy: Phase 1 uncommitted changes preserved; originals snapshotted in .cache/phase2/session-2026-11-04

decisions: Refunds start only from a purchase's overflow Refund action; the repository rechecks the inherited category inside the hashed request.
Over-refund is checked inside the coordinator's exclusive write transaction.
spent == limit shows 'Limit reached' with the warning icon; 'Over by' only when spent > limit.
Analysis lists active Expense categories plus archived ones with rows in range, ranked in SQL by net DESC, name, id; the total equals the sum of listed rows.
Analysis range uses the validated text date editor (no native picker in the pinned APK).
Budget edit keeps category and month fixed; an archived category's existing Budget limit may be edited.
New read methods are async so invalid input rejects instead of throwing inside a screen effect.
bugsFixed: Budgets month with no Budget and no active Expense category showed a bare header instead of the empty state.
Unbudgeted rows with long names collapsed the name column to 4 px on device; rows are now one labelled target with a short visible 'Set Budget'.
